quotes.text: Subtract the unique from the multiplicity to be constituted; write at n - 1 dimensions
The multiple must be made, not by always adding a higher dimension, but rather in the simplest of ways, by dint of sobriety, with the number of dimensions one already has available
Every love is an exercise in depersonalization on a body without organs yet to be formed
it is at the highest point of this depersonalization that someone can be named
The proper name (nom propre) does not designate an individual
at the outcome of the most severe operation of depersonalization, that he or she acquires his or her true proper name
The proper name is the instantaneous apprehension of a multiplicity
The proper name is the subject of a pure infinitive comprehended as such in a field of intensity
There are no individual statements, there never are
Indefinite article + proper name + infinitive verb constitutes the basic chain of expression
The proper name fundamentally designates something that is of the order of the event, of becoming or of the haecceity
It is the military men and meteorologists who hold the secret of proper names, when they give them to a strategic operation or a hurricane
The proper name is not the subject of a tense but the agent of an infinitive. It marks a longitude and a latitude
The HE does not represent a subject but rather makes a diagram of an assemblage
By process of elimination, one is no longer anything more than an abstract line
the indefinite article, the infinitive-becoming, and the proper name to which one is reduced
Such is the link between imperceptibility, indiscernibility, and impersonality
